_about: English realizer declarations: orthography, prepositions, lexicon, agreement, expression candidates per frame, and the reading rules the semantic check applies. The verb lexicon and inflection rules are reused from styles/english.json through its parser; forms it does not declare are added under lexicon_forms.

compound._about: The engine's compound subject (owner, then item) is said as a possessive: owner's item.

numbers._about: How a number is said. Digits by default; numeral words when an expression asks for them.

person._about: The persons of a conversation (meaning.json: holders). user: the words the user says of themself, by the case a reply's part gives the holder (a part with no case: default); the reading the semantic check parses says the user so, and each word is one the pack groups with its first person (임자자리말, 자리말; my is asked of it in docs/requests/W3-1.md). addressee: the words a reply names the user with, by the same cases; a verb that agrees with them takes the second person.

repair._about: The pack's own label for a repair: the word its repair note encloses.

answer_yes._about: The pack's own yes: the word its answer that two counts are the same begins with.

answer_no._about: The pack's own no: the word its answer that two counts differ begins with.

count_none._about: A count of zero: the holder has no X (an answer: No X.).

count_unknown._about: A vague count: the holder has some X, and how many was never said.

transfer._about: Into a place: the giver put the things in it.
Out of a place: the receiver took the things from it.
From one place to another: the things were moved.

recipient_corrected._about: A receiver corrected in place (request G4-1): the same event and its receiver, from the old to the new (I changed the receiver in the same event "…" from Arthur to you.).

chain_statement._about: Why from the trace graph (goal W4): a statement the answer rests on, with its turn.

rules._about: Each rule said in words, by its id. The id itself is never said; it stays in the trace.

subordinate._about: An event an answer is relative to in time: a clause of its own, in the past, after the conjunction, joined to the answer by a comma.

ellipsis._about: A given subject is not said; the answer is the fragment that carries the focus, with its counted noun. An answer with a time clause is not a fragment: it is said in full.

readings._about: How the pack parser's reading of a clause maps back onto frame roles. Used only by the semantic check.

count_none._about: Having none of a thing is read as the count zero, not as a denied count.

follow_ups._about: Questions about the conversation's own last reply, by kind: why_last asks why the last answer or correction came out so; repairs asks what a reading changed. Only these phrasings, compared after punctuation and case.

learning._about: Expression learning from user sentences. live: false means a user's way of speaking never enters replies unless this file declares live: true. Learned expressions serve only the conversation they came from.
